title: Piegan LPOE Housing Complex Parking Garage Babb N2630245 - Amendment 0001
description: The OFFERS DUE DATE is being pushed back to Oct. 22,2026. Currently, RFIs are being answered and additional time is needed. An amendment will be sent out once a response for the RFIs has been completed. Amendment 0001 is to provide responses to the RFIs submitted. Offers due date remains unchanged. Due date: 09/30/2026 by 4:30 PM MST. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, is soliciting proposals for a firm-fixed-price construction contract to construct a new 7-bay enclosed parking garage at the Piegan CBP Housing Complex, located at 5023 US Highway 89 N., Babb, MT 59411. The project includes, but is not limited to, site preparation, grading, utilities, concrete, asphalt paving, electrical work, framing, roofing, interior finishes, inspections, testing, and closeout. The facility will remain operational during construction, and the contractor shall coordinate all work with GSA and tenant agency representatives. This procurement is a Total Small Business Set-Aside and will be awarded using a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) evaluation process. The estimated construction magnitude is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The period of performance is 180 calendar days from Notice to Proceed, with substantial completion required within 120 calendar days. Important Dates Pre-proposal/site visit: September 3, 2026, at 1:00 PM MST RSVP deadline for site visit: August 31, 2026 RFI deadline: September 10, 2026 Anticipated RFI responses: September 17, 2026 Proposal due date: September 30, 2026, by 4:30 PM MST Proposal Requirements Offerors shall submit: Completed SF 1442 Lump-sum price proposal Itemized cost breakdown in CSI format Bid bond Management Plan Key Personnel resumes Representations and certifications Performance and payment bonds will be required after award. Proposals shall be submitted electronically to the Contracting Officer identified in the solicitation.

title: Puunkorjuu Länsi-Suomi 2027, Luontopalvelut
description: Puunkorjuu Länsi-Suomi 2027, Luontopalvelut Metsähallituksen Luontopalvelut pyytää tarjouksia puunkorjuusta ennallistamiskohteilla Kauhajoella, Isojoella ja Karviassa. Kaukaisin etäisyys hakkuukohteiden välillä on noin 50 km linnuntietä. Puunkorjuu sisältää talviaikana toteutettavia harvennus- ja ojalinjahakkuita. Korjuukohteet ovat pääsääntöisesti kantavuudeltaan heikkoja. Hakkuut on toteutettava 1.1.2027-31.3.2027 ja 1.1.2028-31.3.2028 aikana, mutta pakottavien sääolosuhteitten takia voidaan hakkuuaikaa jatkaa 1.1.2029-31.3.2029. Hakattava puumäärä on yhteensä noin 3100 m³ jotka jakautuvat noin 1900m3 talvelle 2027 (4 työkohdetta) ja 1200m3 (2 työkohdetta) talvelle 2028. Mikäli korjuuolosuhteet sallivat, niin talvella 2027 voidaan aloittaa jo tekemään vuoden 2028 kohteita (työkohteita yhteensä 6 kpl). Hehtaarikohtainen kertymä on keskimäärin 40 m³/ha. Hakkuukuvioilla, joissa on pelkkää ojalinjahakkuuta, taksa perustuu uudistushakkuuseen. Hakkuukuvioilla, joissa tehdään ojalinjahakkuun lisäksi myös harvennusta, käytetään kasvatushakkuun taksaa. Puunkorjuu ei sisällä hakkuutähteiden ajoa. Korjuut aloitetaan kaikilla työkohteilla vasta sitten, kun Metsähallitukselta on saatu lupa. Metsähallitus vastaa teiden aurauksista. Hankinta ja sen ehdot sekä vaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Tarjous pyydetään ilmoittamaan kertoimena Metsähallituksen taksataulukkoon perustuen. Tarjouskilpailun perusteella valitaan yksi sopimuskumppani.,

title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category ‘A’ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotland’s records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

title: Finland – Statutory audit services – Espoon kaupungin sekä kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvien tytäryhteisöjen ja säätiöiden tilintarkastuspalveluiden hankinta 2027
description: Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Espoon kaupungin sekä kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvien tytäryhteisöjen ja säätiöiden sekä yhdistyksen tilintarkastuspalveluista tilivuosille 2027-2029 sekä optiona vuosille 2030-2032. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoitusilmoitus on julkaistu HILMA:ssa 30.4.2026. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita markkinavuoropuhelun kautta sekä hyödynnetty asiantuntijanäkemyksiä, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Markkinakartoitusilmoituksessa ei rajattu markkinavuoropuheluun kutsuttavien potentiaalisten tarjoajien määrää. Kartoituksen keskeiset havainnot ovat, että alalla on rajallinen määrä toimijoita, jotka kykenevät toteuttamaan tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hankinnan vaaditussa laajuudessa. Hankinnan toteutus, jossa sekä Espoon kaupungin lakisääteiset tilintarkastuspalvelut että konserniyhteisöjen tilintarkastus toteutetaan saman Toimittajan toimesta rajaa potentiaalisten tarjoajien määrää suhteessa näiden toteuttamiseen erillisinä osa-alueina. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja on hyödynnetty hankinnan kohteen ja soveltuvuusvaatimusten-, tarjousten vertailuperusteiden - sekä sopimusehtojen määrittelyssä. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että hankinnan valmistelu täyttää hankintalain 65 §:n vaatimukset ja tukee kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska sen toteuttaminen yhtenä kokonaisuutena on kustannustehokkain ja tarkoituksenmukaisin vaihtoehto huomioiden kaupunkikonsernin toimintaympäristön. Lisäksi kuntalain 122 §:n mukaan kunnan tytäryhteisön tilintarkastajaksi on lähtökohtaisesti valittava kunnan tilintarkastusyhteisö, ellei poikkeamiseen ole perusteltua tarkastuksen järjestämiseen liittyvää syytä. Hankintayksikön selvityksen perusteella poikkeamiselle ei ole perusteltua syytä. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin lisäisi lisäksi sopimuskauden hallinnollista taakkaa sekä vaikeuttaisi sopimusseurantaa ja palvelun koordinointia. Edellä mainituin perustein hankintayksikkö katsoo, että hankinnan jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, tavoitteet ja toteutustapa huomioon ottaen perusteltua.

title: Kultur|Kloster|Kyritz Los N020 Fliesen- und Plattenarbeiten
description: Bei der geplanten Baumaßnahme handelt es sich um den Umbau des Klausurflügel des ehemaligen Klosters (Bestandsgebäude) zum Museum. Zeitgleich wird daneben ein Neubau (Veranstaltungsgebäude mit Verbindern) errichtet. Das Baugrundstück liegt in Kyritz im Denkmalbereich "Altstadt Kyritz" und dem Bodendenkmal "Altstadt Kyritz". Im Zuge der Sanierung und Herrichtung des Veranstaltungsgebäudes werden Fliesen- und Plattenarbeiten in den Sanitärbereichen sowie in ausgewählten Sonderbereichen ausgeführt. Die Arbeiten umfassen die Lieferung und Verlegung keramischer Wand- und Bodenbeläge einschließlich aller erforderlichen Nebenleistungen, Untergrundvorbereitungen sowie Anschluss- und Abdichtungsarbeiten. In den Sanitärbereichen sind Wand- und Bodenflächen auf vorhandenen Estrichen, Stahlbetonwänden sowie Gipskartonuntergründen mit keramischen Belägen zu versehen. Vorgesehen ist die Ausführung von ca. 40 m2 Wandbelägen sowie ca. 45 m2 Bodenbelägen. Die Ausführung erfolgt einschließlich notwendiger Grundierungen, Abdichtungen im Spritzwasserbereich, Bewegungs- und Anschlussfugen sowie dauerelastischer Verfugungen. Darüber hinaus erfolgt im historischen Klausurflügel die fachgerechte Verlegung historischer Mettlacher Fliesen. Die Arbeiten in diesem Bereich sind unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der denkmalpflegerischen Anforderungen sowie unter Erhalt und behutsamer Einbindung der historischen Bausubstanz auszuführen.

title: Työnhaun ohjaus ja -neuvontapalvelu
description: Työnhaun ohjaus ja -neuvontapalvelu Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden asiakkaille. Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu on ennakoivaa, työttömyyttä ehkäisevää ja nopeaa työllistymistä edistävää palvelua. Palvelu luokitellaan työnhakuvalmennukseksi. Palvelun tavoitteena on edistää ja nopeuttaa asiakkaiden työllistymistä sekä mahdollistaa asiakkaiden omatoiminen ja tehokas työnhaku. Tavoitteena on tarjota asiakkaille selkeät ja ajantasaiset ohjeet ja työkalut työnhakuprosessin tueksi, vahvistaa asiakkaiden työnhaun taitoja ja lisätä heidän ymmärrystään omasta osaamisestaan, työmarkkinoista sekä yrittäjyydestä. Palvelu on suunnattu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden työnhakijoille, jotka tarvitsevat matalalla kynnyksellä apua työnhakuun, työllistymiseen sekä työelämässä tarvittaviin tietoteknisiin taitoihin tai työllistymisen esteiden tunnistamiseen. Palvelua toteutetaan ensisijaisesti verkossa ja palveluntuottajan järjestämissä tiloissa Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden alueella (Mikkeli, Kangasniemi, Juva, Hirvensalmi, Mäntyharju ja Puumala). Toteutuksen pääpaino on verkkowebinaareissa, joita voi itsenäisesti suorittaa ja joihin kuuluu yksilöohjausta. Lisäksi palvelu voi asiakkaan tarpeesta riippuen olla yksilöpainotteista valmennusta tai palvelua voidaan toteuttaa ryhmämuotoisena valmennuksena. Ryhmämuotoisen valmennuksen toteutus voi olla verkossa tai lähivalmennuksena. Myös eri teemaiset infotilaisuudet mahdollisia. Palvelun suunniteltu toteuttamisaika on 1.1.-31.12.2027. Lisäksi mahdollisuus kolmeen (3) yhden vuoden mittaiseen optioon seuraavasti: 1. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2028 2. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2029 3. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2030 Arvio palveluun ohjautuvasta asiakasmäärästä 500 asiakasta / vuosi. Arvio ei sido tilaajaa eikä aseta määräostovelvoitetta tilaajalle. Tarkempi kuvaus palvelusta on ilmaistu liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa.,

title: Kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut
description: Kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalvelut Aalto-yliopistokiinteistöt Oy (Y-tunnus: 2842681-2), tilaajaorganisaatioidensa puolesta ja lukuun, pyytää tarjousta Aalto-yliopiston kiinteistöjen nostolaitteiden huolto- ja korjauspalveluista, jäljempänä Palvelu tai Palvelut, tässä tarjouspyynnössä asetettujen ehtojen ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintaan osallistuvat tilaajaorganisaatiot (jäljempänä myös ”Tilaaja”) on lueteltu tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 3 ”Tilaajaorganisaatiot” (tarjouspyyntöhetken tilanne). Hankintaan osallistuvien kiinteistöjen määrät, laajuudet ja vastaavat voivat muuttua sopimuskaudella Tilaajan tarpeiden mukaisesti eikä Tilaajalla ole määräostovelvoitetta. Tarjoajien edellytetään huomioivan tämä tarjousta antaessaan. Tällä hetkellä nostolaitteita on vain Otaniemen kampuksella 17 eri rakennuksessa. Nostolaitteita on rakennuksissa tällä hetkellä 64 kpl. Hankinta sisältää eri nostolaitteiden vuosihuoltopalveluita, koekuormituksia ja määräaikaistarkastuksia, sekä laitteisiin tarvittavia korjauksia. Hankintasopimus tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa olevaksi palvelusopimukseksi. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan kohteesta on tarjouspyynnön liitteillä Cloudia Tarjouspalvelussa. Aalto-yliopistona toimiva Aalto-korkeakoulusäätiö sr (Y-tunnus 2228357-4) omistaa tällä hetkellä 20 erillistä kiinteistöosakeyhtiötä. Näissä kiinteistöosakeyhtiöissä on 39 rakennusta, joihin palvelua tilataan ja jotka sijaitsevat Otaniemen kampuksella Espoossa, yksi Töölössä Helsingissä ja yksi Kirkkonummella (Metsähovin radiotutkimusasema). Aalto-yliopiston rakennukset ovat kulttuurihistoriallisesti arvokkaita kiinteistöjä eri vuosikymmeniltä 1960- luvulta lähtien. Palvelun kohteena oleviin kiinteistöihin ja yliopiston kampuksiin voi tutustua virtuaalisesti alla olevien linkkien kautta osoitteissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rc7lhmaFYc0&t=1s https://virtualtour.aalto.fi/ Tarjoajille tarjotaan mahdollisuus tutustua paikan päällä kahden eri kohteen nostolaitteisiin tiistaina 6.10.2026 klo 12.00-14.00 tai perjantaina 9.10.2026 klo 9.00-11.00. Kierrokselle ilmoittaudutaan 2.10.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä sähköpostiosoitteeseen mia.mustonen@aalto.fi ja mikko.aho@aalto.fi. Molemmilla kierroksilla esitellään samat kohteet ja niiden nostolaitteet. Kohdekierroksella ei ole mahdollisuus esittää kysymyksiä, vaan kaikki kysymykset koskien palvelua esitetään tarjouspalveluportaalissa kirjallisesti 13.10.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä.,

title: Anskaffelse av konsulenttjenester for støtte til videreutvikling av en produktorientert og smidig organisasjon
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å inngå en kontrakt om kjøp av konsulenttjeneste som kan bidra i vårt arbeid med å styrke Mattilsynets evne til å arbeide smidig, tverrfaglig og verdiorientert i hele organisasjonen. Formålet er å bidra til at virksomheten: styrker sin smidige modenhet etablerer og videreutvikler effektive myndiggjorte team forbedrer flyt fra behov til levert verdi styrker kontinuerlig læring og forbedring utvikler ledere og medarbeidere i smidig ledelse og arbeidsform reduserer unødvendige avhengigheter, flaskehalser og koordinering får bedre sammenheng mellom virksomhetens mål, prioriteringer og teamenes arbeid bygger intern kompetanse slik at virksomheten i størst mulig grad blir selvhjulpen over tid. Et sentralt mål med oppdraget er læring og kompetansebygging i organisasjonen gjennom aktiv kunnskaps- og erfaringsoverføring fra konsulenten til våre ansatte. Konsulenten skal primært bidra til varig kompetansebygging og utvikling av virksomhetens arbeidsformer. Oppdraget skal derfor ikke begrenses til å introdusere eller følge opp enkeltstående smidige metoder eller rammeverk. Vi søker en konsulent som evner å se sammenhengen mellom mennesker, team, ledelse, organisering, styring og verdiskaping i et smidig perspektiv.

title: Belgium – Compressors – Delivery of a Mobile Recompression Unit and the performance of the associated services
description: Delivery of a Mobile Recompression Unit and performance of the associated services for methane emission reduction during depressurisation activities on Fluxys’ gas network installations. The scope includes the design, manufacturing, supply, inspection and testing, shipping, commissioning, user training and start-up of a complete mobile recompression unit, including all equipment required for the compression process and associated maintenance and support services. The unit must be powered by a gas engine, installed in an outdoor enclosure, suitable for use with high-calorific gas and gas mixtures containing up to 10% hydrogen, and designed to recompress gas from pressure reducing lines, pig traps and isolated pipe sections for reinjection into the Fluxys network. The unit must comply with applicable Belgian legislation and European directives, minimise natural gas emissions, and be designed to provide the most economical CAPEX/OPEX solution. As an option, the Contractor shall also offer the integration of the unit on a flatbed truck of approximately 4.5 m x 2.1 m.

title: Ireland – Economic research services – Consultancy Services to prepare a Strategic Assessment and Preliminary Business Case in relation to the provision of Irish-language based early-years (Naíonra) facilities in Dún Gar
description: Naíonra Garbháin was established in 1981 as an early-immersion Irish-language based educational setting for pre-school children in Dún Garbhán and the surrounding areas. Dún Garbhán is a Baile Seirbhíse Gaeltachta (Gaeltacht Service Town). Naíonra Garbháin provides education and childcare services for people from the Gaeltacht who do not have access to housing in An Rinn or An Sean Phobal and who live in the surrounding area. Naíonra Garbháin is managed by a voluntary committee known as Croí na nÓg. As it is located immediately adjacent to the Irish-language based primary school, Scoil Gharbháin, progression from the Naíonra to the primary school is seamless and therefore the Naíonra is an important foundation and integral part of life on the Scoil Gharbháin campus. As the population of the town of Dún Garbháin, and in particular the area adjacent to the Naíonra, continues to grow, Croí na nÓg wishes to ensure that the facilities provided in the town of Dún Garbháin are sufficient to cater for the demand for Irish-language based education for pre-school children in the town. It also wishes to ensure that suitable facilities are available to cater for the demand for Irish-language based pre- and post-school services in the area. The latter is particularly important as a significant number of parents of primary school travel into Dún Garbháin on a daily basis for employment and are likely to avail of such services if they were available. Croí na nÓg have recently purchased lands immediately adjoining the Department of Education and Skills lands upon which Scoil Gharbháin is constructed and wish to ensure that the lands are utilised in the most efficient manner possible to meet the Irish-language based early education and pre/post school service demands of the area. Croí na nÓg wish to appoint a consultant to undertake a Strategic Assessment and Preliminary Business Case as envisaged in the Infrastructure Guidelines and the tender documents to improve the range of early-years educational and pre/post school services in the area.

title: Romania – Research, testing and scientific technical simulator – „Echipamente pentru cercetare industrilala aferenta activitatii Cercetare a subsistemelor pentru vehicule electrice aeriene si a utilizarii energiei regenerabile in aplicatii de mobilitate electrica – Partea a II-a”
description: Furnizare „Echipamente pentru cercetare industrilala aferenta activitatii Cercetare a subsistemelor pentru vehicule electrice aeriene si a utilizarii energiei regenerabile in aplicatii de mobilitate electrica – Partea a II-a” necesare în cadrul proiectului „Ro-Green Sustainable Electric Mobility Solutions”, cod SMIS 336225, finanțat prin Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare 2021–2027 (PCIDIF). Contractului de Finanțare nr. 390085/11.11.2025, conform caietului de sarcini, in vederea dezvoltarii de soluții avansate de mobilitate verde, până la nivelul TRL 9, prin integrarea tehnologiilor moderne în domeniul mobilității electrice terestre și aeriene, ceea ce va permite: • Consolidarea capacității de cercetare și inovare în mobilitate verde la nivel regional. • Extinderea colaborării public–private și creșterea competitivității partenerilor industriali. Specificațiile tehnice care indică o anumită origine, sursă, producție, un procedeu special, o marcă de fabrică sau de comerț, un brevet de invenție, o licență de fabricare sunt menționate doar pentru identificarea cu ușurință a tipului de produs și nu are ca efect favorizarea sau eliminarea anumitor operatori economici sau a anumitor produse, aceste specificații vor fi considerate ca având mențiunea ”sau echivalent” cu excepția situației unde se specifică altceva. Se vor achizitiona: Software simulare electromagnetică – 1 buc., Stație lipire cu IR – 1 buc., Sistem de măsurare a forței de tracțiune pentru aparate de zbor – 1 buc., Simulator lumină solară – 1 buc., Sistem de analiză electrică și spectrală – 1 buc., Sistem integrat de testare și analiză energetică DC/AC – 1 buc. conform caietului de sarcini. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de termenul limita de depunere ale ofertelor. Numarul de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere ale ofertelor este de 18 zile.

title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category âAâ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotlandâs records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Professional Estate Management Services Framework
description: National Records of Scotland (NRS) operates across an estate comprising five buildings, four of which are located in Edinburgh (three being Category âAâ listed) and one in Dumfries. The historic and cultural significance of these assets requires the engagement of suppliers with demonstrable expertise in conservation led estates services and operational, specialist archival storage facilities and a clear understanding of the statutory, technical and professional requirements associated with working within protected and sensitive environments. Such services are critical to ensuring that NRS can continue to fulfil its role as custodian of Scotlandâs records, while maintaining safe, compliant and functional accommodation for collections, staff and, where applicable, members of the public. NRS shares many common estate management challenges and requirements with other Scottish Government sponsored organisations, including Historic Environment Scotland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Each partner organisation is responsible for the stewardship of nationally important, and in many cases listed or protected, operationally specialist buildings, landscapes and collections. These estates require a consistent, high quality and conservation focused approach to professional services, delivered by suppliers with proven experience of working within complex heritage environments. NRS has invited partner organisations to establish a joint Framework Agreement for professional estates services. The framework aims to secure access to a suitably skilled and diverse supply base with specialist technical and conservation expertise, reduce duplication of procurement activity, and provide a compliant, efficient and flexible mechanism through which participating organisations can call off services as required. This collaborative approach is intended to support value for money, improve service quality and resilience, and ensure that all organisations are able to discharge their custodial responsibilities effectively and sustainably over the life of the framework. Services that may be called off under the Framework include (but are not limited to): Multi disciplinary technical and design services (including architectural and engineering); Conservation led consultancy for listed and historic buildings; Support to in house estates and facilities teams, including specialist advice and surveys; Project and construction management; Health and safety, fire safety, asbestos surveys and management and water safety (including legionella) services; Planned maintenance planning, inspections, condition surveys and compliance support.

title: Container, Assembly
description: This is a solicitation for non-commercial products prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)/Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13 as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division (NSWC IHD), located in Indian Head, Maryland, intends to award a firm-fixed-price (FFP) purchase order using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Container, Assembly. This solicitation will be competed as a total small business set-aside. Solicitation Details Quotes are being requested under Request for Quotations (RFQ) N0017426Q1124. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 332439 and the associated small business size standard is 600 employees. The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through the FAR/RFO. This RFQ incorporates all provisions and clauses in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 and the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) DPN 20260507. Technical Drawings If interested, technical drawings need to be requested by contractor prior to submission date. ITAR certification is required to be provided prior to technical drawing release. Drawing requests must be made via email to Francine.l.keys.civ@us.navy.mil , and marlene.l.ridgell.civ@us.navy.mil by Thursday , 13 OCTOBER 2026, 8:00 AM EST. Cybersecurity Compliance Requirement (CMMC Level 1): For purposes of technically acceptability, the Offeror shall submit documentation verifying an active CMMC Level 1 Self-Assessment recorded in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS). If the Offeror does not possess an active SPRS entry at the time of proposal submission, the Offeror will not be deemed technically acceptable. Basis for Award The Government will award a purchase order resulting from this solicitation to the responsible vendor whose quote conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The Government intends to evaluate all timely quotes received from eligible vendors on a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) basis. The Government intends to evaluate quotations and award a purchase order without discussion. Evaluation Factors: Technical: Quotes must reflect the required specifications and the exact brand specified in the Statement of Work. Price: Quotes must include all applicable costs, including shipping and handling. Questions and Clarifications Questions regarding this requirement must be submitted via email to Francine.l.keys.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 29 September 2026. All answers will be provided by 15 October, 2026. Submission Instructions Quote packages are due by 22 October, 2026, at 08:00 AM EST. Late quotes will not be considered. Quote packages shall be sent via email to Francine.l.keys.civ@us.navy.mil and must contain a cover sheet that provides the following information: Official Company Name; Point of Contact (including name, email address, and phone number); and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and CAGE Code.

title: Cabot Tower Signal Mast Replacement, Signal Hill National Historic Site
description: 5P468-26-0234/A Cabot Tower Signal Mast Replacement, Signal Hill National Historic Site BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires the removal of the existing signal mast, and the supply and install of a new signal mast atop of Cabot Tower. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than March 31, 2027. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT It is recommended that the Bidder or a representative of the Bidder visit the work site. Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at at the entrance door for Cabot Tower, located at 230 Signal Hill Rd, St. John's, NL A1C 5M on October 14, 2026. The site visit will begin at 10:30am NDT. Bidders must communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than October 12 at 12:00pm NDT to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders must also complete and submit a certification. Bidders who do not confirm attendance, provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend, or who do not complete and submit the above certification as required will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) calendar days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

title: Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankinta
description: Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankinta Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelun hankintaan. Hankinnan kohteena oleva palvelu sisältää Espoon kaupungin sekä sen konserniyhtiöiden (Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat, Espoon Asunnot Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli, Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus, Weegee Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio) omistamien tai hallinnoimien rakennusten, tilojen ja toimipisteiden keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelut. Rakennukset sijaitsevat Espoon kaupungin alueella. Tilaajalla on myös muita sopimuksia, joita käytetään kuljetusominaisuuksiltaan vaaralliseksi jätteeksi luokiteltuun SER-jätteeseen sekä muun tietoturvamateriaalin poistopalvelussa. Suurin osa mm. perustietotekniikasta poistetaan tämän sopimuksen kautta. Tarjoaja voi toteuttaa osan palvelusta alihankintana. Tietoturvamateriaalin käsittelyä ja siihen liittyviä palveluita ei saa toteuttaa alihankintana, henkilöstövuokrauksella eikä muiden yksiköiden tai voimavarayksiköiden henkilöstöä käyttämällä. Palvelu tulee tuottaa kokonaisuudessaan tarjoajan omalla henkilöstöllä ja omana toimintana. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Sopimus solmitaan yhden (1) Toimittajan kanssa. Lisäksi valitaan yksi (1) varatoimittaja. Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassaoleva. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on 717 000 (alv. 0 %). Eurot jakaantuvat hankintayksiköiden välillä seuraavasti: Espoon kaupunki 150 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt 20 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat 50 000€ Espoon Asunnot Oy 447 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus 10 000€ Weegee Oy 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio 10 000€ Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Hankinnan valmistelun yhteydessä toteutettiin markkinakartoitus potentiaalisista toimittajista tutustumalla hankinnan kohteena olevia palveluita tarjoavien toimittajien verkkosivuihin. Kartoituksessa tunnistettiin useita markkinoilla toimivia toimittajia. Hankintayksikkö lähestyi 8 toimittajaa lähettämällä 12.5.2026 tekniseen vuoropuheluun osan tarjouspyyntömateriaalista kommentoitavaksi sekä hankintaan liittyviä kysymyksiä vastattavaksi. Näistä kaksi yritystä vastasi kirjalliseen kommentointiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun tuloksia hyödynnettiin tarjouspyyntömateriaalin viimeistelyssä. Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut kirjallisen selvittelyn perusteella, että hankinnan kohteena oleville palveluille on olemassa toimivat markkinat ja että markkinoilla voi olla useita potentiaalisia toimittajia mutta kirjalliseen vuoropuheluun vastanneiden määrä jäi vähäiseksi. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja hyödynnettiin hankinnan kohteen määrittelyssä, palvelutasovaatimusten arvioinnissa, hinnoittelurakenteen kehittämisessä sekä soveltuvuus- ja referenssivaatimusten tarkentamisessa. Hankinnan valmistelussa on huomioitu hankintalain 65 §:n mukaiset markkinakartoitusta koskevat periaatteet ja hankintayksikkö katsoo valmistelun tukevan kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin ja SER-jätteen poistopalvelut muodostavat toiminnallisesti yhtenäisen palvelukokonaisuuden. Palveluiden tilaaminen, kohdehallinta, raportointi, laskutus ja Sopimuksen seuranta ovat samankaltaisia riippumatta poistettavasta jätejakeesta. Yhden toimittajan malli vähentää hallinnollista työtä, selkeyttää vastuunjakoa sekä tehostaa palvelun koordinointia Tilaajan laajassa ja hajautuneessa kohdeverkostossa. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, toteutustapa ja tarkoituksenmukainen toteutus huomioon ottaen perusteltua.,

title: Ireland – Sensors – BE3917F - RFT to establish a Single Supplier Framework for the Supply, Delivery, Installation and Support of a Campus Occupancy Sensing Solution for Trinity College Dublin (TCD)
description: Tenders are sought for the Supply, Delivery, Installation and Support of an enterprise-grade Campus Occupancy Sensing Solution for Trinity College Dublin. A Campus Occupancy Sensing Solution captures and reports how spaces are used across the estate. It is intended to provide Trinity with accurate, anonymous occupancy and space-utilisation data across the timetabled teaching estate to inform space management, timetabling, energy and HVAC optimisation, and capital planning. The requirement is to be delivered in phases over the term of the framework, with an initial call-off, and the solution must integrate with Trinity’s existing enterprise network and information systems. Tenderers are asked to provide detailed responses to the requirements set out in Appendix 1 below. This procurement establishes a framework agreement for the supply, installation and support of a range of campus sensing solutions over its four-year term. The first call-off under the framework is for occupancy sensing in timetabled teaching spaces, as specified in Appendix 1. Subsequent call-offs may, at the Contracting Authority’s sole discretion and subject to available budget, extend to other categories of campus sensing, including but not limited to building-occupancy sensing, environmental sensing (for example temperature, humidity and CO₂ / air quality) and energy and sub-metering sensing. The Contracting Authority gives no commitment or guarantee as to the volume, value or timing of any call-off, including in respect of these additional categories. Detailed technical requirements for sensor categories beyond the first call-off occupancy requirement will be defined at the relevant call-off stage.

Asiakkaina on myös rintamaveteraaneja ja sotainvalideja sekä omaishoidontuen piirissä olevia asiakkaita. title: Industry Day for Outcome-Based Rapid Business Integration and Technology (ORBIT) Multiple Award (MA) Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ)
description: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), Office of Acquisition Management (OAQ), and Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) will host an Industry Day for the ORBIT IDIQ. Disclaimer: THIS INDUSTRY DAY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. THIS DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT FROM RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT, NOR DOES IT OBLIGATE THE GOVERNMENT TO PRODUCE A SOLICITATION IN THE FUTURE. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY INTERESTED PARTIES IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY AND NO COMPENSATION WILL BE PROVIDED FOR RESPONSE PREPARATION OR FOLLOW-UP REQUESTS. Program Overview: To better reflect our mission-focused objectives and the integrated, agile nature of our future operations, the contract vehicle formerly known as SWIFT has been rebranded as ORBIT: Outcome-Based Rapid Business Integration and Technology. ORBIT provides a flexible, future-ready framework that will allow us to deliver integrated solutions with the speed and agility our mission demands. We look forward to leveraging this vehicle to drive organizational success and adapt to the challenges of an evolving operational environment. Strategic Context: While our original SWIFT IDIQ successfully established a foundation for rapid task initiation, our mission requirements have matured. We are now moving beyond siloed, platform-specific tasking to a model focused on continuous assembly, integration, and improvement of technical capabilities across the existing ICE environment. The name ORBIT represents this next stage of our technological maturity�a framework where Super Intelligence (SI), data, platforms, and collaboration are not managed in isolation, but are strategically integrated to support ICE�s broader operational mission. Key Program Pillars: Align. Integrate. Deliver.: Our new tagline reflects our focus on ensuring technology is seamlessly integrated to drive measurable mission outcomes. Outcome-Based Delivery: We are shifting from static, manual oversight to dynamic SLAs tied directly to delivery and measurable business results. Integrated Functional Streams: The ORBIT domain model organizes our work around mission functional streams (e.g., Mission Platforms, SI/Automation, Enterprise Data, Digital Experience, and Portfolio Integration), resolving previous scope ambiguities and reducing fragmented task orders. Commitment to Continuity: A core objective of this transition is to preserve the continuity of our existing IT landscape. ORBIT fully incorporates the scope for Operations & Maintenance (O&M) and ongoing enhancement activities for all products established under the legacy SWIFT vehicle. Moving Forward: The transition to ORBIT represents a refinement, not a wholesale replacement, of our enterprise vehicle. We are preserving the core strengths that make our current IDIQ successful�including ICE OCIO management, enterprise IT scope, multiple-award competition, and task-order flexibility�while fundamentally enhancing our ability to govern and integrate complex technical dependencies. description: Titel: Metallbauarbeiten Fenster und Türen Beschreibung: Die gesamte Baumaßnahme umfasst den Neubau eines Feuerwehrgebäudes auf dem Grundstück am Ferdinand-Porsche-Ring in Tarp, bestehend aus einer Fahrzeughalle mit 8 Stellplätzen, die von einem eingeschossigen Anbau mit angegliederter Küche von Süden und Westen „umklammert“ wird. Die hierfür neu herzustellenden Außenanlagen bestehen aus einer gebäudeumschließenden Zufahrtsstraße beginnend an der Zufahrt vom Ferdinand-Porsche-Ring zu den Besucher- und Alarmstellplätzen mit Anschluss an die südöstliche Übungsfläche und an den Hallenvorplatz nördlich der Fahrzeughalle Diese Ausschreibung umfasst die Metallbauarbeiten der Fenster und Türen Folgende Hauptleistungen sind u.a. im Rahmen dieser Ausschreibung zu erbringen: - Alu-Fensterelement, ca. 2 – 7m², 14 Stück - Alu-Fenster-Türelemente mit Einsatztüren, ca. 7 – 14 m², 4 Stück - Alu-Außentürelemente tlw. mit Oberlichtern, ca. 2 – 5 m², 9 Stück - Alu-Innentürelemente mit Oberlichtern, ca. 6 m², 2 Stück - T30 Alu-Innentürelemente, ca. 4 m², 1 Stück - T30 Stahlblechtüren, ca. 2 – 4m², 4 Stück - T0 Stahlblechtüren, ca. 2 – 3m², 8 Stück - Linear gehaltene Ganzglasvordächer, ca. 1,5m², 2 Stück

title: AI-POWERED OFFICIAL LANGUAGES LEARNING SOLUTION
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) is exploring tools to support employees in learning their second official language (English or French) in response to evolving operational and legislative requirements. The modernization of the Official Languages Act has reinforced the importance of maintaining and strengthening bilingual capacity across the organization to ensure compliance with the Agency's obligations to serve Canadians and support employees in the official language of their choice. Investing in effective and accessible second-language learning solutions will help the CRA maintain its bilingual capacity, support succession planning, and continue providing high-quality services in both official languages. As a result, the CRA is assessing the feasibility of implementing a scalable, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered language learning solution aligned with CRA corporate requirements and Government of Canada requirements. Responding to this Request for Information (RFI) is not a prerequisite to being eligible to bid on any subsequent solicitation. Any subsequent solicitation will be advertised on the Government Electronic Tendering Service commonly referred to as CanadaBuys. This RFI is not to be construed as a solicitation for tenders or proposals. No contract or other form of commitment will be entered into based on responses to this RFI. This RFI is not authorization by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) to undertake any work that would result in costs to the CRA. RFI Closing Date Responses must be received on or before October 22, 2026, no later than 14:00 EDT. All responses to this Request for Information must be directed in writing and submitted by email to: Contracting Authority: Charles Safarian E-mail: charles.safarian@cra-arc.gc.ca It is recommended that all electronic submissions contain a read receipt option to confirm that the email was received. Respondents are requested to provide a contact name, email address and telephone number when submitting their response. Please refer to the solicitation documents for further information and instructions regarding this opportunity.

title: Workshops for Black and Ethnocultural Offenders
description: Advanced Contract Award Notice An advanced contract award notice (ACAN) is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date and time stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement does not apply to this procurement. 1. Definition of the requirement: The Correctional Service of Canada (CSC) has a requirement to provide culturally responsive writing and storytelling circles and workshops for Black and ethnocultural federally incarcerated offenders located in various CSC institutions across Ontario, Quebec, Prairie and Atlantic regions. CSC has legal and policy obligations to ensure that the needs and cultural interests of Black and ethnocultural offenders are addressed through effective interventions and services that support rehabilitation and successful reintegration. The work will involve the following: 1.1 Objectives: 1.1.1. Provide opportunities for Black and ethnocultural offenders to explore self-expression, identity development, and their experiences with multiple identities living between cultures, through writing and storytelling activities, contributing to increased self-awareness, self-esteem, emotional well-being and sense of belonging. 1.1.2. Promote respect, inclusivity, and meaningful connections among and between offenders and community partners, contributing to improved interpersonal, communication and coping skills that support rehabilitation; 1.1.3. Support offenders’ reintegration potential by increasing awareness of and connections to relevant community resources and services available during and after incarceration. 1.2 Tasks: The Contractor must perform the following tasks, including but are not limited to: 1.2.1. Develop and deliver writing and storytelling circles and workshops for incarcerated Black and ethnocultural offenders (participants); 1.2.2. Coordinate workshop scheduling and delivery with CSC staff and designated institutional contacts; 1.2.3. Provide workshop materials and participant resources required for workshop delivery and provide information on relevant community supports and services; 1.2.4. Utilize culturally responsive and participant-centred facilitation approaches throughout workshop delivery; 1.2.5. Deliver workshops in English and French, as required. 1.3 Expected results: The expected results for the subsequent contract include, but are not limited to: 1.3.1. Participants are provided with culturally relevant workshops designed to support self-expression and identity exploration. 1.3.2. Participants are provided with information on relevant community resources and supports. 1.3.3. Workshops include facilitated group discussions and activities designed to promote respect, inclusion and positive social interaction 1.3.4. Workshops are delivered in accordance with CSC requirements, approved schedules and cultural responsiveness principles. 1.3.5. Workshop materials and participant resources are developed and provided in accordance with contract requirements. 1.3.6. Summary reports are provided to CSC following workshop delivery in accordance with contract requirements. 1.4 Performance standards: The workshop content, materials and activities must be reviewed and approved by CSC prior to delivery and must align with the mission, values and ethics of the Correctional Service of Canada, in accordance with Commissioner's Directive 001. Content may be adapted to meet regional priorities and the needs of participating offender populations, subject to CSC approval. 1.5 Deliverables: The Contractor must provide the following deliverables, including but not limited to: 1.5.1. Deliver writing and storytelling circles and workshops, as requested by CSC regions and institutions, in collaboration with CSC staff, as required. 1.5.2. Deliver workshops at institutions across Ontario, Quebec, Atlantic and Prairie regions, up to a maximum of 45 workshops. Each workshop will be approximately two (2) hours in duration and must be delivered between contract award and March 31, 2027. 1.5.3 Develop and provide bilingual workshop materials and participant resources. 1.5.4. Provide Verbal and written updates to the Project Authority, upon request, regarding program delivery, including any barriers, challenges, observations, and recommendations. 1.5.5. Provide electronic summary reports to Project Authority no later than four (4) weeks following the completion of each activity at each institution Reports must include: a. Date(s) of workshop delivery; b. Number of participants; c. Workshop highlights; and d. Any observations, challenges, and recommendations related to program delivery. 1.6 Paper consumption: a. Should printed material be required, double sided printing in black and white format is the default unless otherwise specified by the Project Authority. b. The Contractor must ensure printed material is on paper with a minimum recycled content of 30% and/or certified as originating from a sustainably managed forest. c. The Contractor must recycle unneeded printed documents (in accordance with Security Requirements). 1.7 Constraints: 1.7.1 Location of work: a. Preparation work will be completed at the contractor’s premises. Workshops must be delivered in person at CSC institutions and at other CSC-approved locations within the Quebec, Ontario, Prairies and Atlantic regions. Due to the sensitive nature of the services being provided, in-person sessions are required. In exceptional circumstances, and only where the institution has the capability to accommodate it, a virtual session may be considered to replace the in-person session (e.g. severe weather conditions preventing safe travel). b. Travel Travel to various CSC institutions across Ontario, Quebec, Prairie and Atlantic regions will be required for the performance of the work. The Contractor is responsible for making all travel arrangements necessary to perform the Work and must ensure that workshop delivery schedules are met. No travel expenses will be reimbursed under the Contract. 1.7.2 Language of Work: Workshops delivered in the Quebec region must be delivered in both official languages. Workshops in all other CSC regions must be delivered in English. All workshop materials must be available in the language of delivery. Participants will communicate and express themselves in the official language of their choice. 1.7.3 Security Requirements: This contract includes the following security requirements: a. The contractor/offeror and its personnel shall be always escorted when accessing government facilities or any restricted work site. b. The contractor/offeror and its personnel shall not be granted access to any PROTECTED or CLASSIFIED information or assets. c. In accordance with Commissioner’s Directives 566 8 Searching of Staff and Visitors and 566 1 Control of Entry to and Exit from Institutions, the contractor/offeror and its personnel requiring access to institutional settings must comply with all security requirements set out in these directives, including but not limited to being subject to searches prior to entry. Correctional Service Canada reserves the right, at any time, to deny contractor personnel access to any institution, site, or part thereof. 2. title: Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7
description: NOTICE OF PROPOSED PROCUREMENT Canada has a requirement for the item detailed below: GSIN: N1375 – Demolition Materials UNSPSC: 46101600 –Ammunition Description: Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 A requirement exists to resupply Canada with the Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7. The Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 is required as the first step of an explosive shockwave in an explosive train when using a non-electric method of initiation. It is functioned by inserting an igniferous burning fuse into the open end and being crimped onto the burning fuse. When the flame from the burning fuse exits the end of the fuse, it ignites a primary explosive composition which in turn transfers a shockwave into the secondary explosive component in the Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7. The Cap Blasting Non-Electric M7 is primarily used in military applications for demolition purposes. Quantity: 3,000 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Dundurn, Dundurn, Saskatchewan on or before 01 November 2027. 3,500 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Angus, Angus, Ontario on or before 01 November 2027. 3,000 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Dundurn, Dundurn, Saskatchewan between 01 September 2028 and 30 November 2028. 3,500 units - Delivery to Canadian Forces Ammunition Depot (CFAD) Angus, Angus, Ontario between 01 September 2028 and 30 November 2028. title: Germany – Installation of fitted kitchens – Küchentechnik
description: Auf dem innerstädtischen Grundstück der Königsegg-Grundschule in Immenstadt wird die bestehende Sporthalle zurückgebaut und durch einen Ersatzneubau mit Sporthalle, Verwaltung für Schule und Hort, Kinderhort und Mensa ersetzt. Die beengte innerstädtische Lage erfordert eine kompakte Lösung am Standort der bisherigen Halle. Im Neubau entstehen eine Einfeldsporthalle mit Nebenräumen im Untergeschoss, Verwaltungsräume für Schule und Hort im Erdgeschoss sowie ein zweigeschossiger Hortbereich für ca. 250 Kinder in den beiden Obergeschossen. Eine Mensa mit Küche für ca. 105 Kinder befindet sich ebenfalls im 2. OG. Die Nutzung erfolgt durch Grundschule, Hort und Ganztagsklassen. Die Anbindung an den Bestand erfolgt barrierefrei mit einem neuen Aufzug im Neubau. Begleitende Umbauten im Schulgebäude ermöglichen die Umnutzung bestehender Horträume für Ganztagsklassen. Die Fachräume im UG-Bestand bleiben erhalten und stehen ebenfalls auch dem Hort zur Verfügung. Der Neubau wird in Massiv- und Holzbauweise errichtet. Die Sporthalle und das EG bestehen aus Stahlbeton, die Obergeschosse aus Holzrahmen- und Holztafelbau. Das Dach ist als versetztes Pultdach mit Gründach und Blechdeckung ausgeführt. Die Fassade kombiniert Faserzementplatten und Holzverkleidung. Die Außenanlagen werden neu strukturiert. Es entstehen eingefriedete Freiflächen für Schule und Hort, sowie ein neuer Allwetterplatz. Ausgeschrieben wird diese Maßnahme in Einzelgewerken.

title: Q999--GCH Technologies - Vanity Short Codes Annual Lease
description: This intent to sole source announcement is posted in accordance with FAR 5.2 Synopses of Proposed Contract Actions. Objective The Department of Veterans Affairs, VISN 05, VACO VA Central Office, Veterans Crisis Line (VCL) requires exclusive leasing, management, and maintenance of SMS vanity short codes 838255 ( VETALK ) and 98801 ( 988, press 1 ) to support 24/7/365 crisis text messaging services. These short codes are mission-critical assets that ensure immediate, reliable access to crisis intervention resources. The contemplated period of performance is 12/22/2026 through 12/21/2027 (Base + four option years) Unique Qualifications GCH Technologies Inc. is the only known responsible source capable of fulfilling these requirements. Supporting justification from the Single Source Justification (P03) includes: GCH Technologies holds exclusive control and carrier-level ownership of short codes 838255 and 98801. Vanity short codes cannot be reassigned without the current owner s cooperation. Replacement of these codes would require full public rebranding, disrupt routing infrastructure, and pose unacceptable risks to continuity of crisis services and public safety. Technical research confirms no other vendor can legally or technically provide these exact short codes. Award Information The incumbent contractor shall be provided with the opportunity to present a quote that shall be accepted as a firm fixed price agreement at the lowest price technically acceptable (LPTA). The Government anticipates the Independent Cost Estimate shall be developed and comparable with the current Contract No. 36C24525P0022 to justify fair and reasonable pricing. The period of performance shall be for one base year period, not to exceed 12-months. The Period of Performance reads as follows: 12/22/2026-12/21/2027 If anyone requests additional information or would like to obtain a copy of the statement of work (SOW) for more details Cassie (KC) White cassie.white@va.gov
